subject: Seedpool subsidy request from CloudSeed Labs for SI-led marketplace pilots
messages:
From: Anna Liu <anna@cloudseed.com>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Cc: procure@cloudseed.com
Date: 2026-06-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: 'Seedpool' promotional credits to kick off SI pilot cohort

Hi Diego —

Great to reconnect. CloudSeed is putting together a small cohort of SI-led pilots to showcase our joint marketplace listings. We talked about Redwood offering partner-sourced promo credits (a 'seedpool') so SIs can spin up short pilots without procurement friction.

High level ask: would Redwood consider providing a pooled promo allocation that our SIs can draw from? Initial ask: 10 pilot slots, up to ~$5k equivalent each (we estimate ~25k token-equivalent per pilot). Proposed expiry: 180 days from issuance.

Attached: Seedpool_T&Cs.pdf (draft MOU) and usage_estimate.csv (per-pilot projection).

Questions for you:
- Is Redwood open to issuing a single code or portal allocation that multiple SI teams can redeem, or do you prefer per-pilot single-use codes?
- Any limitations on stacking with other promos?
- Typical turnaround to approve and provision?

We can also sign a short MOU; forwarded for procurement visibility.

Thanks — happy to hop on a quick call if helpful.

Anna Liu
Partnerships, CloudSeed Labs
anna@cloudseed.com

From: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Liu <anna@cloudseed.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-21T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 'Seedpool' promotional credits to kick off SI pilot cohort

Anna —

Thanks for the note and the attachments, useful context. Looping Vanessa from Partner Ops to weigh in operationally. A few clarifying items so we can size this properly:

1) Per-pilot cap: you mentioned ~$5k equivalent. Is that a strict cap or average expected consumption? If some pilots run longer, do you want a buffer?
2) Redemption model: do you prefer one multi-use allocation (seedpool) that CloudSeed tracks, or distinct single-use codes per pilot (simpler auditing on our end)?
3) Attribution & reporting: you requested console access — do you need a dashboard read-only view for CloudSeed or periodic CSV exports?
4) Legal/T&Cs: Vanessa — please flag any dealbreakers in the attached draft.

Tentative timeline: if we align on model and T&Cs by EOD tomorrow, ops could likely provision codes within 3 business days.

Diego
Partner Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Anna Liu <anna@cloudseed.com>
Date: 2026-06-21T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 'Seedpool' promotional credits to kick off SI pilot cohort

Hi all —

Quick operational read: I think we can support this as a partner-sourced allocation. Recommended approach:

- Issue a single 'seedpool' allocation that we map to CloudSeed (multi-redeem pool). Easier for CloudSeed to distribute to SIs and for us to reconcile draws.
- Set hard per-pilot cap of $5,000 (token-equivalent) and a global pool cap of $50,000 (to cover the 10 pilots + 1 buffer).
- Expiry: 180 days from issuance (matches ask).
- Attribution: we can provide a weekly CSV export of redemptions to CloudSeed; if you need read-only console access we can evaluate least-privilege view but that usually takes extra infra work.

Couple of items I asked Legal to check in the draft T&Cs: indemnity clause and data-handling language. Once Legal signs off, Finance needs a GL/account code for the promotion.

Diego — if you approve the budget and Sean confirms accounting code, I can kick off provisioning.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Anna Liu <anna@cloudseed.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-21T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 'Seedpool' promotional credits to kick off SI pilot cohort

Thanks Vanessa — that model works for CloudSeed.

Couple of small asks:
- If possible, allow us to reassign unused allocation to a different SI within the 180-day window, rather than forfeiting (we'll provide an internal redistribution log).
- DocuSign: I'm attaching the updated MOU with the redistribution clause. Happy to route the MOU back to Redwood legal; we prefer a lightweight signature process.

DocuSign link (for CloudSeed signature): https://docusign.example/records/ABCDEF123456

If you can confirm the weekly CSV cadence, we can prep our internal ops to consume it.

Anna Liu
CloudSeed Labs
anna@cloudseed.com

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-22T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: 'Seedpool' promotional credits to kick off SI pilot cohort

All —

Reviewed the proposal and finance is good to approve under the following conditions:

- Accounting: code PROMO_PARTNER_2026, GL 6501. Please use this code when provisioning so we can track consumption.
- Budget: cap global pool at $50,000; any draws beyond that require explicit sign-off from Revenue Ops.
- Expiry: 180 days from issuance (no auto-extension).
- Redistribution: allow reassignments among CloudSeed SIs only if CloudSeed provides an auditable redistribution register; Redwood will not permit transfers outside of CloudSeed's namespace.

Vanessa — please open the provisioning ticket with Platform Ops once the final MOU is signed and include the attachments (Seedpool_T&Cs.pdf, usage_estimate.csv). Ops should create the pool, configure per-pilot cap, and enable weekly CSV exports to anna@cloudseed.com.

Diego — approving on my end for budget and accounting.

— Sean
Sean Gallagher

Redwood Inference
